title: Ramsons RHW 30
subtitle: Horizontal Washing Machine (Side-Loading Stainless Steel, 30 kg)

purposeAndApplication.purpose: The RHW 30 is the 30 kg-capacity model in the same RHW horizontal washing machine range as the RHW 200 above (siblings: 15/30/50/75/100/150/200), sharing the same core design. Wet-processing (washing) of linen and garments at smaller (30 kg) batch capacity, with a raised door design for better liquor holding ratio and a stainless steel chemical dispenser.

overviewDescription: Made by Ramsons Garment Finishing Equipment Pvt. Ltd. (Bengaluru, Karnataka, India). Horizontal side-loading drum with hot-forged end flange shafts. Reduction pulley system or gearbox-and-pulley system.
